mapper.sql: id, order_id, product_id, user_id, rating, content, created_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO evaluations (order_id, product_id, user_id, rating, content, created_at) VALUES (#{orderId}, #{productId}, #{userId}, #{rating}, #{content,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{createdAt,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP})
mapper.select: SELECT e.id, e.order_id, e.product_id, e.user_id, e.rating, e.content, e.created_at, u.username FROM evaluations e LEFT JOIN users u ON u.id = e.user_id WHERE e.product_id = #{productId} ORDER BY e.created_at DESC, e.id DESC
SELECT FROM evaluations WHERE order_id = #{orderId} ORDER BY id ASC
